entries: **Quota-aware mode now tells Claude when Claude Code or Codex has an official service incident.** When Claude Code / Claude API or Codex API is degraded or down, Claude gets one line saying so. For Codex it also says not to keep retrying a failed dispatch or debugging the task brief, and to switch agents or tell you instead. Claude hears it once per conversation, again if the status changes, and once more when the service recovers. The app writes these statuses to `~/.usage/service_status_snapshot.json`; statuses older than 15 minutes are ignored.

**Quota-aware mode tells Claude once when a quota it warned about resets.** The next prompt clears the earlier notice, including when a new quota window starts early, and includes current usage when known. Only quotas warned about in that conversation trigger a reset notice. Records for other conversations stay for up to seven days after reset so resumed conversations can hear it too.

**Quota-aware mode gives Claude a short quota overview at the start of each conversation.** It shows each tool’s known usage and reset time once, skips stale data, and waits for usable data if none is available yet. The same switch controls the overview and existing notices.

**Quota-aware mode tells Claude once when you switch Claude Code accounts with `/login`.** Earlier Claude Code quota notices no longer apply, and old account readings stay suppressed until the status file updates after your next reply. Other tools and conversations keep their own records.

**Quota-aware mode now tells Claude the reset clock time and the current time.** Each reminder used to give only the time left, such as `resets in 2h 10m`. It now adds the local clock time, such as `(at 02:40 local time)`, and a `Current local time` line, so Claude can tell you when a quota resets instead of only how long it takes. A reset on another day also shows the weekday.

**usage no longer opens Google sign-in pages in the background when the Antigravity CLI is signed out.** When a background `agy` run reports it is not signed in, usage stops starting `agy` in the background until the sign-in works again, and runs at most one background `agy` at a time. After you sign in again, the next refresh reads the quota right away instead of waiting 30 minutes.

**The Antigravity weekly quota no longer disappears after one failed read.** The card keeps the last weekly reading, marked as old data, until its reset time. The status line and quota-aware notices also treat the kept weekly reading as old data.

**The Antigravity status line shows when each quota resets.** Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages it now prints the reset clock time and the time left, for example `18:37(2h30m left)`, in the same format as the Claude Code status line.

**The Antigravity status line now uses two lines, like the Claude Code one.** Project and quota windows stay on the first line, and the model and context window move to the second, so the reset times still fit in an 80-column terminal instead of being dropped first.

**Terse mode keeps replies readable while it shortens them.** Its instructions now set a floor: the reader gets each reply in one pass. They ask for common word pairings and the verb near its subject, and keep connecting words such as "because" and "so". This follows a recent study that found pressure to be brief is one cause of hard-to-read AI text.

**Codex subagent threads are counted again.** A thread started by `spawn_agent` repeats the parent's session header but no longer its token events, so usage could not match it to the parent and skipped the whole file. These threads are now counted from zero; on the machine where it was found, about 0.4% of Codex tokens had been missing.
**Fable 5.2 has an offline price and a short name.** Costs for it no longer show as missing when the price table cannot be downloaded, and it appears as `Fable 5.2` in tables and charts.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 狀態列改為雙排顯示，補上額度重置時刻與剩餘時間
title.en: Antigravity status line switches to two lines, adding quota reset times and time remaining

body.zh-TW: 緊盯著邊長受限的終端機視窗趕工時，最怕算不清手邊的呼叫配額何時重置。⟦走進候車亭看動態看板，以前單排螢幕擠不下完整字樣，抵達時間常最先被裁切；現在改成分層播送，上方列出路線、下方顯示倒數分鐘，小螢幕也能一眼看齊。⟧Antigravity 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在採用雙排設計，排版樣式比照 Claude Code。第一排固定保留專案與額度視窗，第二排則放模型與上下文視窗（模型一次可處理的內容容量）。在 5 小時和每週額度的百分比旁，會直接印出重置時刻與剩餘時間，例如 `18:37(2h30m left)`，意思是 18:37 重置、還剩 2 小時 30 分鐘。即使終端機只有 80 格寬，重置時間依然放得下，不再被優先省略。
body.en: When rushing through work while watching a space-constrained terminal window, the worst feeling is losing track of when active call quotas reset. ⟦Think of checking a dynamic display at a bus shelter: where a single-row screen once could not fit all text and cut off arrival times first, a tiered broadcast now lists routes on top and countdown minutes below, letting small screens show everything at a glance.⟧ Antigravity's status line (the status display at the bottom of the terminal) now uses a two-line layout modeled after Claude Code. The first line keeps project and quota windows, while the second line holds the model and context window (the amount of content a model can process at once). Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages, it prints the reset clock time and time left, such as `18:37(2h30m left)`, meaning it resets at 18:37 with 2 hours and 30 minutes left. Even if the terminal is only 80 columns wide, reset times still fit and are no longer dropped first.

items.original:
**The Antigravity status line shows when each quota resets.** Next to the 5-hour and weekly percentages it now prints the reset clock time and the time left, for example `18:37(2h30m left)`, in the same format as the Claude Code status line.
**The Antigravity status line now uses two lines, like the Claude Code one.** Project and quota windows stay on the first line, and the model and context window move to the second, so the reset times still fit in an 80-column terminal instead of being dropped first.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式兼顧文字可讀性，縮短回覆依然讀一遍就懂
title.en: Terse mode preserves readability, keeping shortened replies clear in one pass

body.zh-TW: 請 AI 簡明扼要回答問題時，最常遇到文字被過度壓縮而難以理解的窘境。⟦報社主編濃縮長篇通訊，以前為了塞進有限版面猛砍連接詞，讀者讀起來反而滿頭問號；現在改寫時要求句型完整且詞語自然，篇幅變短卻依然一讀就通。⟧精簡模式（terse mode，縮減回覆長度的輸出模式）現在替回覆品質設下底線，要求讀者讀一遍就能看懂。這套指示要求語句採用常見的慣用搭配詞，動詞必須盡量靠近主詞，並強制保留「因為」與「所以」等關鍵連接詞。這項改進依據一項最新研究：逼迫 AI 寫短，正是其文字變得晦澀難懂的原因之一。
body.en: When asking an AI for concise answers, users often encounter text compressed so heavily that it becomes hard to understand. ⟦Picture a newspaper editor condensing long dispatches: where conjunctions were once aggressively cut to fit limited space and left readers puzzled, rewrites now require complete sentence structures and natural phrasing so shortened copy remains clear in one pass.⟧ Terse mode (an output mode that shortens reply length) now sets a quality floor, requiring that readers understand each reply in one pass. These instructions require common word pairings, keep the verb as close as possible to its subject, and mandate preserving key connecting words such as "because" and "so". This improvement follows a recent study: pressuring AI to be brief is itself one reason its text becomes obscure and hard to understand.

items.original: **Terse mode keeps replies readable while it shortens them.** Its instructions now set a floor: the reader gets each reply in one pass. They ask for common word pairings and the verb near its subject, and keep connecting words such as "because" and "so". This follows a recent study that found pressure to be brief is one cause of hard-to-read AI text.

title.zh-TW: Codex 子代理用量重新計入，獨立統計不再整份略過
title.en: Codex subagent usage is counted again, tracked independently instead of skipping whole files

body.zh-TW: 指揮背景代理分頭處理繁重任務之後，翻開用量報告卻可能發現統計數據對不上。⟦工讀生協助分裝包裹，以前簽收單雖寫著總部抬頭卻漏貼明細，會計對不上總帳便整批退件；現在獨立開立單據從零計算，派工產生的開銷全部如實入帳。⟧由 `spawn_agent` 啟動的子代理執行緒會複製父層工作階段的開頭標頭，卻不再複製父層的 token（計量 AI 處理與計費的文字單位）事件。過去 usage 因為無法將它對齊父對話，會將整份紀錄檔直接略過。現在這類子代理紀錄已改為從零開始統計。在發現此問題的電腦上，先前大約少算了 0.4% 的 Codex token 用量。
body.en: After directing background agents to handle heavy tasks in parallel, opening a usage report might reveal figures that fail to match. ⟦An intern helps pack parcels: while receipt slips once showed headquarters headers but omitted itemized details, prompting accounting to reject whole batches when totals failed to match, independent invoices are now issued from scratch so all dispatch expenses are recorded faithfully.⟧ A subagent thread launched by `spawn_agent` copies the header of the parent session, but no longer copies the parent's token (the text unit used to measure AI processing and billing) events. Previously, because usage could not match it to the parent conversation, it skipped the entire log file. These subagent records are now counted from zero instead. On the machine where this issue was found, about 0.4% of Codex token usage had previously gone uncounted.

items.original: **Codex subagent threads are counted again.** A thread started by `spawn_agent` repeats the parent's session header but no longer its token events, so usage could not match it to the parent and skipped the whole file. These threads are now counted from zero; on the machine where it was found, about 0.4% of Codex tokens had been missing.

title.zh-TW: Fable 5.2 補上離線價格備援，圖表統一顯示簡稱
title.en: Fable 5.2 adds an offline price fallback, displaying a short name across charts

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線工作的場合，查看模型支出報表常會因為缺乏即時價目而留下空白。⟦便利商店刷條碼結帳，以前連不上總部系統就直接顯示無此商品，發票品名也印得落落長；現在機台內建離線公定價，收據上更統一印出簡潔的商品代號。⟧針對 Fable 5.2 模型，系統現在內建了離線價格設定。價目表無法下載時，Fable 5.2 的費用也不再顯示為缺漏。各類用量表格與統計圖表也統一將其名稱標示為簡潔的 `Fable 5.2`。
body.en: When working offline or experiencing a network disconnection, reviewing model spending reports often left blanks because real-time pricing was unavailable. ⟦At a convenience store barcode checkout, losing connection to headquarters once prompted registers to display items as missing while printing overly long names on receipts; machines now embed offline list prices and consistently print concise product codes instead.⟧ For the Fable 5.2 model, the system now includes built-in offline pricing. When the price table cannot be downloaded, costs for Fable 5.2 no longer show as missing. Usage tables and charts also consistently display its name as the concise `Fable 5.2`.

items.original: **Fable 5.2 has an offline price and a short name.** Costs for it no longer show as missing when the price table cannot be downloaded, and it appears as `Fable 5.2` in tables and charts.

entries: **The Antigravity Gemini weekly quota keeps updating on networks that only allow traffic through a proxy.** The pre-launch check from 0.34.14 connected to Google directly, so behind a proxy it always looked offline and the CLI never ran. A configured HTTPS proxy now counts as online; a bare `NO_PROXY` setting still runs the check.
**The offline check can no longer hold up a refresh when DNS hangs after a wake.** Its 3-second limit now covers the name lookup, not just the connection.

**The Antigravity auto-start window keeper now follows the Gemini quota, whichever model group the card shows.** It always sends its message to a Gemini model, but decided from the displayed group, so with Claude/GPT or Argon selected it started the window at the wrong time or never.
**The Gemini weekly quota no longer jumps into the 5-hour row in its last five hours.** When usage falls back to Google's model list, a weekly limit close to its reset was mistaken for a 5-hour one.
**Signing in to Antigravity again takes effect on the next refresh.** After Google rejected the sign-in, usage kept retrying the rejected token for up to an hour.
**A damaged Antigravity quota cache no longer hides the card for good.** An unreadable cache file is now moved to `~/.usage/quarantine/` and the quota is fetched fresh.
**On Windows, the taskbar countdown starts and clears promptly with the panel closed.** It could lag up to five minutes when a quota filled or reset between refreshes.

title.zh-TW: 代理網路正常更新額度，喚醒網址查詢不再拖住刷新
title.en: Quotas Update Normally over Proxy Networks, Wake-Up URL Queries No Longer Stall Refreshes

body.zh-TW: 在特定企業內網工作時，你可能需要透過代理伺服器（替電腦轉發對外請求的中介伺服器）連上外部網路。v0.34.14 新增的啟動前檢查會直接連線 Google，導致走代理的環境總被判定成離線，造成工具無法執行。現在只要設定好 HTTPS 代理就會視為連線成功，每週額度也能正常更新，僅設定 `NO_PROXY` 時則照常檢查。⟦宛若大樓警衛核對訪客，以前只認正門直達通道，走接駁車通道就被當成缺席，翻閱名冊卡住時還會堵住入口；現在認可接駁登記，查名冊的時間也計入等待上限。⟧電腦睡眠喚醒若遇到網域名稱查詢卡住，原本 3 秒的上限現在連同查網址的時間一併計算，不再拖住資料刷新。
body.en: When working on certain corporate intranets, you might need to connect to external networks through a proxy server (an intermediary server forwarding outbound requests for a computer). The pre-launch check added in v0.34.14 connected directly to Google, which caused environments behind a proxy to always be judged offline and prevented tools from running. Now, configuring an HTTPS proxy counts as a successful connection and weekly quotas update normally, while setting only `NO_PROXY` continues to run the check as before. ⟦Think of a building security guard checking visitors who previously only recognized the direct front entrance, treated anyone arriving via shuttle bus as absent, and clogged the gate whenever flipping through the guest registry stalled; now shuttle check-ins are recognized, and registry lookup time counts toward the waiting limit.⟧ If a domain name query hangs when waking from computer sleep, the original 3-second limit now includes the URL lookup time as well, no longer stalling data refreshes.

items.original:
**The Antigravity Gemini weekly quota keeps updating on networks that only allow traffic through a proxy.** The pre-launch check from 0.34.14 connected to Google directly, so behind a proxy it always looked offline and the CLI never ran. A configured HTTPS proxy now counts as online; a bare `NO_PROXY` setting still runs the check.
**The offline check can no longer hold up a refresh when DNS hangs after a wake.** Its 3-second limit now covers the name lookup, not just the connection.

title.zh-TW: 自動開窗改依 Gemini 額度判斷，切換其他模型組不再誤判時機
title.en: Auto-Start Window Keeper Now Follows Gemini Quota, Switching Model Groups No Longer Misjudges Timing

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟 Antigravity 的自動保持開窗功能時，背後機制會依照額度狀態決定觸發視窗的時間點。⟦跟工廠派車載貨一樣，司機固定駕駛卡車，調度員以前卻看展示架上的小客車油表決定發車，導致在錯的時間出發或乾脆不出勤；現在改看卡車的油量，不再算錯發車時機。⟧該功能一律向 Gemini 模型送出訊息，以前卻依照卡片上目前顯示的模型組來判斷額度。當你選取了 Claude、GPT 或 Argon 模型組時，開窗機制便會在錯誤的時間啟動，甚至完全不開窗。現在開窗判定已經改為直接追蹤 Gemini 的額度，無論介面切換到哪一個模型組，都不會再錯過時機。
body.en: When you enable Antigravity's auto-start window keeper feature, the underlying mechanism determines when to trigger a window based on quota status. ⟦Picture a factory dispatching freight trucks: the driver always operates a truck, but dispatchers previously checked the fuel gauge of a sedan on display to schedule trips, leading to departures at the wrong time or no runs at all; now they monitor the truck's fuel level, no longer miscalculating dispatch timing.⟧ This feature always sends messages to a Gemini model, but previously evaluated quota based on whichever model group the card currently displayed. When you selected the Claude, GPT, or Argon model group, the window mechanism would start at the wrong time or never open at all. Now the windowing decision directly tracks Gemini's quota, so whichever model group the interface switches to, it will no longer miss the timing.

items.original: **The Antigravity auto-start window keeper now follows the Gemini quota, whichever model group the card shows.** It always sends its message to a Gemini model, but decided from the displayed group, so with Claude/GPT or Argon selected it started the window at the wrong time or never.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 額度誤歸類與快取異常已修復，重新登入下一次刷新生效
title.en: Antigravity Quota Misclassification and Cache Anomalies Fixed, Signing In Again Takes Effect on Next Refresh

body.zh-TW:
平常查看 Antigravity 的配額時，資料歸類與本機狀態的異常現在都已修正。當 usage 讀取 Google 模型清單作為備援（原本方式行不通時改用的替代方案）時，快要重置的 Gemini 週額度在最後五小時內，過去會被誤認成 5 小時額度而跳到錯的欄位，現在已經不再跳列。

當 Google 拒絕登入時，先前 usage 會拿同一張被拒的授權令牌（驗證身分的存取記號）重複嘗試最長達一小時。現在重新登入 Antigravity 之後，下一次刷新就會直接套用新憑證。

如果本機的額度快取（暫存查詢結果的檔案）發生損壞，過去會讓卡片永久消失。讀不了的檔案現在會自動移至 `~/.usage/quarantine/` 隔離，並重新抓取全新額度。
body.en:
When checking Antigravity quotas, anomalies in data classification and local state have now been fixed. When usage reads Google's model list as a fallback (an alternative used when the primary method fails), a Gemini weekly quota close to reset was previously mistaken for a 5-hour quota in its final five hours and jumped into the wrong row, which no longer happens.

When Google rejected a sign-in, usage previously kept retrying with the same rejected authorization token (an access credential used to verify identity) for up to an hour. Now after signing in to Antigravity again, the next refresh applies the new credentials directly.

If the local quota cache (a file temporarily storing query results) was corrupted, it previously caused the card to disappear permanently. Unreadable files are now automatically moved to `~/.usage/quarantine/` for quarantine, and fresh quotas are fetched.

items.original:
**The Gemini weekly quota no longer jumps into the 5-hour row in its last five hours.** When usage falls back to Google's model list, a weekly limit close to its reset was mistaken for a 5-hour one.
**Signing in to Antigravity again takes effect on the next refresh.** After Google rejected the sign-in, usage kept retrying the rejected token for up to an hour.
**A damaged Antigravity quota cache no longer hides the card for good.** An unreadable cache file is now moved to `~/.usage/quarantine/` and the quota is fetched fresh.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板關閉時，工作列倒數即時出現與消失
title.en: On Windows, Taskbar Countdown Appears and Clears Promptly with Panel Closed

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用工作列圖示掌握進度時，即使沒打開面板也能即時看見倒數狀態。⟦就像錄音室門外的提示燈號，以前房門關著時，門外燈號更新總慢半拍；現在開關一切換，門外的提示燈立刻同步亮起或熄滅。⟧以前當額度在兩次刷新之間剛好用滿或重置時，只要面板（顯示詳細額度的快顯視窗）處於關閉狀態，工作列上的倒數計時最多會慢五分鐘才更新。現在這項延遲已經修正，即使面板沒有保持開啟，工作列倒數也會在額度用滿或重置的瞬間即時出現與消失。
body.en: When using the taskbar icon on Windows to track progress, you can now see the countdown status promptly even without opening the panel. ⟦Just as with an indicator light outside a recording studio, updates to the light lagged behind whenever the studio door stayed closed; now the moment a switch flips, the outside indicator turns on or off in lockstep.⟧ Previously, when a quota happened to fill or reset between two refreshes, as long as the panel (a popover window displaying detailed quotas) remained closed, the taskbar countdown could take up to five minutes to update. This delay has now been fixed, so even if the panel is not kept open, the taskbar countdown appears and clears promptly the moment a quota fills or resets.

items.original: **On Windows, the taskbar countdown starts and clears promptly with the panel closed.** It could lag up to five minutes when a quota filled or reset between refreshes.

entries: **The Windows taskbar quota label counts down to recovery.** When the tray provider's 5-hour or weekly window hits 100%, the label shows the time left (for example `Claude: 2h55m`) in the full-quota color instead of `100%`, matching the macOS menu bar. While it counts down, the label refreshes every interval even with the panel closed.

**Antigravity no longer opens a Google sign-in page in your browser after the Mac wakes from sleep.** Right after a wake the network is often still down, and the Antigravity CLI treated the failed token refresh as "not logged in", opening one new sign-in tab each time. usage now skips the CLI while Google's sign-in server is unreachable, and after a failed CLI check it waits 30 minutes before launching it again instead of retrying on every refresh, which also covers an expired sign-in or captive-portal Wi-Fi. The quota card keeps showing the last reading meanwhile. Thanks to @teddy123434 for the report and fix (#297, #301).

**Switching the Antigravity card between model groups no longer sends false notifications.** The notifier kept one state for all groups, so moving from a used-up Gemini group to Argon read as a reset ("quota is back") and moving back sent "used up" again. Each model group now keeps its own state on macOS and Windows.

**Reports show Codex detail for days before August 2026 again.** Older ledger days kept only a daily total, so cards and the tool breakdown started at 2026-08-01 while the heatmap went further back. Those days are now filled once from Codex's local thread database by date, model and project; tokens that cannot be attributed show as "unknown", and nothing is guessed as Claude. Backfilled tokens carry no cost and count as "no pricing data".
`scripts/check_upstream.py` no longer reports usage's own `_rate_limits_session_id` status field as a new upstream field.

title.zh-TW: Windows 工作列額度標籤顯示恢復倒數，滿額即時掌握剩餘時間
title.en: Windows taskbar quota label displays recovery countdown to track remaining time when full

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Windows 上專注編寫專案，把 AI 額度用到上限時，不必再反覆點開面板確認何時能繼續。以前系統匣選定的服務在 5 小時或本週額度達到 100% 時，工作列上的標籤只會停留在 `100%`。現在達到滿額後，標籤會改用滿額代表色直接顯示剩餘恢復時間（例如 `Claude: 2h55m`），與 macOS 選單列的顯示方式一致。⟦停車場門口的車位看板以前只亮著客滿紅燈，駕駛得搖下車窗詢問才知何時有空位；現在滿額時直接切換為預估等待時間，即使閘門關著也持續倒數。⟧在時間倒數期間，就算面板處於關閉狀態，標籤也會在每個輪詢週期照常更新。
body.en: When you are focused on writing a project on Windows and reach your AI quota limit, you no longer need to repeatedly open the panel to check when you can continue. Previously, when the tray's selected service hit 100% of its 5-hour or weekly quota, the label on the taskbar simply stayed at `100%`. Now once the quota is reached, the label switches to the full-quota color to directly show the remaining recovery time (for example `Claude: 2h55m`), matching how the macOS menu bar displays it. ⟦A parking lot display sign previously only stayed lit with a red full light, forcing drivers to roll down their windows to ask when a spot would open; now it switches directly to an estimated wait time when full, continuing to count down even while the gate remains closed.⟧ During the countdown, the label still updates every polling cycle even when the panel is closed.

items.original: **The Windows taskbar quota label counts down to recovery.** When the tray provider's 5-hour or weekly window hits 100%, the label shows the time left (for example `Claude: 2h55m`) in the full-quota color instead of `100%`, matching the macOS menu bar. While it counts down, the label refreshes every interval even with the panel closed.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 睡眠喚醒不再狂開登入頁，切換模型組也各自記錄通知
title.en: Antigravity sleep wake no longer opens repeated sign-in pages, while switching model groups tracks notifications separately

body.zh-TW: 如果常讓 Mac 進入睡眠，或是經常在面板切換模型組，兩處惱人的誤判提示現在都不會再跳出。剛喚醒時網路常常尚未就緒，以前 Antigravity CLI（終端機指令列工具）更新授權令牌失敗就當成未登入，每次刷新都多開一個登入分頁。現在連不上 Google 登入伺服器時先略過 CLI；檢查失敗後等 30 分鐘再啟動，登入過期或 Wi-Fi 需先開網頁登入時也適用，額度卡則沿用上次的數字。切換模型組也不再共用狀態。以前從用完的 Gemini 切到 Argon 會誤發額度恢復，切回又通知已用完；現在 macOS 與 Windows 都各自記錄。⟦進出管制實驗室時，門禁系統以前在主機離線時會狂響補登警報，換用不同門禁卡也把舊紀錄拿來亂按鈴；現在離線時先安靜等待，不同清單也各自記錄。⟧
body.en: If you frequently put your Mac to sleep or often switch model groups in the panel, two annoying false-positive prompts will no longer appear. Right after waking, the network is often not yet ready, and previously the Antigravity CLI (a terminal command-line tool) treated a failed token refresh as being not logged in, opening an extra sign-in tab on every refresh. Now it skips the CLI when unable to reach Google's sign-in server; after a failed check, it waits 30 minutes before launching again, which also applies to expired sign-ins or Wi-Fi requiring web login, while the quota card continues to use the previous numbers. Switching model groups also no longer shares state. Previously, switching from a depleted Gemini group to Argon would falsely notify that quota had recovered, and switching back would notify again that it was used up; now macOS and Windows each track them separately. ⟦When accessing a restricted lab, the access control system previously blared re-registration alarms whenever the host was offline, and rang false bells with old records when switching access cards; now it waits quietly while offline, and records different lists separately.⟧

items.original:
**Antigravity no longer opens a Google sign-in page in your browser after the Mac wakes from sleep.** Right after a wake the network is often still down, and the Antigravity CLI treated the failed token refresh as "not logged in", opening one new sign-in tab each time. usage now skips the CLI while Google's sign-in server is unreachable, and after a failed CLI check it waits 30 minutes before launching it again instead of retrying on every refresh, which also covers an expired sign-in or captive-portal Wi-Fi. The quota card keeps showing the last reading meanwhile. Thanks to @teddy123434 for the report and fix (#297, #301).
**Switching the Antigravity card between model groups no longer sends false notifications.** The notifier kept one state for all groups, so moving from a used-up Gemini group to Argon read as a reset ("quota is back") and moving back sent "used up" again. Each model group now keeps its own state on macOS and Windows.

title.zh-TW: 報表補齊 Codex 歷史細項，八月以前對話紀錄重現卡片分布
title.en: Reports backfill Codex historical details to restore card distributions for conversations before August

body.zh-TW: 翻閱用量報表追蹤歷史消耗時，八月以前的詳細分佈現在也能正常查閱。以前較舊的帳本只儲存每日總量，導致卡片與工具分佈只能從 2026-08-01 開始顯示，即使熱度圖有更早的紀錄也無法查看細項。現在這些日子會從 Codex 本機的對話資料庫補齊一次，按照日期、模型與專案進行整理。無法歸屬的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）會直接顯示為「unknown」，不會任意猜成 Claude。補回的資料不含金額，統一計入「沒有價格資料」。⟦氣象觀測站補建歷史圖表時，以前老檔案只記下每日總雨量，分類圖只能從八月畫起；現在從儀器本機日誌單次補齊數據，無法辨識的數值直接記為未註明，絕不隨意猜成其他測站。⟧
body.en: When browsing usage reports to track historical consumption, detailed breakdowns prior to August can now also be viewed normally. Previously, older ledger days stored only daily totals, causing card and tool breakdowns to display only from 2026-08-01, even though the heatmap had earlier records. Now these days are backfilled once from Codex's local thread database, organized by date, model, and project. Unattributable tokens (the text units AI processes and bills for) are displayed directly as "unknown" rather than arbitrarily guessed as Claude. Backfilled data carries no monetary cost and is uniformly counted under "no pricing data". ⟦Think of a weather station reconstructing historical charts: old archives previously only recorded daily total rainfall, leaving breakdown charts able to start only from August; now data is backfilled once from local instrument logs, with unidentifiable readings directly recorded as unspecified and never casually guessed as other stations.⟧

items.original: **Reports show Codex detail for days before August 2026 again.** Older ledger days kept only a daily total, so cards and the tool breakdown started at 2026-08-01 while the heatmap went further back. Those days are now filled once from Codex's local thread database by date, model and project; tokens that cannot be attributed show as "unknown", and nothing is guessed as Claude. Backfilled tokens carry no cost and count as "no pricing data".

title.zh-TW: 上游檢查腳本不再把內部狀態欄位誤報為上游新欄位
title.en: Upstream check script no longer falsely reports internal status field as new upstream field

body.zh-TW: 平時透過本機腳本追蹤上游服務的變更時，欄位檢查的提示現在更乾淨。以前執行 `scripts/check_upstream.py` 檢查上游狀態時，usage 內部的 `_rate_limits_session_id` 狀態欄位，會被檢查工具誤當成上游服務新推出的欄位而跳出警示。現在不再將它誤報為上游新欄位。⟦圖書館採購組核對新書目錄時，以前常把館員寫在頁邊的借閱註記當成出版社推出的全新書目；現在不再把那筆註記當成新書目。⟧
body.en: When tracking upstream service changes through local scripts, field check alerts are now cleaner. Previously, when running `scripts/check_upstream.py` to inspect upstream status, usage's internal `_rate_limits_session_id` status field was mistaken by the check tool for a newly introduced upstream field, triggering a warning. It is now no longer falsely reported as a new upstream field. ⟦Picture a library acquisitions team checking a new book catalog: previously, borrowing notes scribbled in page margins by staff were often mistaken for brand-new titles released by publishers; now that annotation is no longer treated as a new entry.⟧

items.original: `scripts/check_upstream.py` no longer reports usage's own `_rate_limits_session_id` status field as a new upstream field.

entries: **Choose quota-alert thresholds from the menu.** "Usage Alert Notifications" is now a submenu on macOS and in the Windows tray: an on/off switch plus 50/70/80/90/95% checkmarks. A threshold added below current usage waits for the next real crossing instead of firing at once.
**The menu tells you when macOS notification permission is off.** An item opens Notification settings, so alerts that would never arrive no longer look enabled.

**The classic panel is cleaner.** Card titles and project numbers are quieter so percentages and red alerts stand out, the color bar on the left of each card is gone, and the compact layout (four or more quota cards) also tightens the projects card and footer.

**Codex's "updated … ago" label is no longer a warning.** Codex has no live report, so an older reading is normal; every panel theme and the Claude Code side pane now show it in muted text without ⚠. Antigravity keeps its warning, since an old value there means a fetch failed.
**"Session" reads "5 hours" in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.**

**Beginner mode stops hinting words you type yourself.** If a term such as PR or commit appears in your own message, it no longer comes back as a hint. Asking what a word means ("launchd 是什麼") does not count, and marking the term as not understood in the history pane brings it back.

**After switching Claude accounts with `/login`, the quota reminder no longer reports the previous account's quota as yours.** A new session reuses the last known numbers until its first reply; the status line hook now records which session observed them, and the quota reminder ignores numbers from another session.
**The quota reminder no longer repeats the same Antigravity warning in one conversation.** Antigravity's reset time drifts by up to a minute between readings, which looked like a new quota window.

**An older copy of usage no longer downgrades the hooks a newer one installed.** Self-repair used to reinstall any hook whose version differed, so two copies could keep swapping it; it now only upgrades.

**The Muse quota card no longer spends a model call on every refresh.** With Muse 1.4.13 or later, usage reads the allowance from `muse usage --json`, which runs no model. Older Muse versions, or a window with no reading yet, still fall back to the one-line `muse exec` check.

**Session handoffs only list commits and edits that succeeded.** A commit rejected by a pre-commit hook or a failed edit no longer shows as done, and `!` shell commands are no longer listed as your last request.

**Status-line and launch-at-login switches no longer fail silently.** The status-line switch is on only for usage's own hook, a failed install says so, and a refused launch-at-login registration shows the reason.
**Session hooks are repaired even when another tool owns the Claude status line.** The quota reminder also says when a tool's numbers are an hour or more old and the window may have reset.
**Quitting the app stops a hung `muse usage` check.**

title.zh-TW: 額度提醒可直接勾選通知門檻
title.en: Choose quota alert thresholds directly from the menu

body.zh-TW:
請 AI 幫忙改報告時，想提早知道額度快用完，可以先到選單挑提醒的百分比。⟦烤箱以前只有提醒開關，現在可以選好要在哪個刻度響鈴；把提醒刻度設在目前讀數以下，也不會補響，而是等下次真的跨過才提醒。⟧

macOS 與 Windows 系統匣（集中顯示常駐程式圖示的區域）的「用量提醒通知」改成子選單，裡面有總開關，以及 50／70／80／90／95% 的勾選項目。新加的門檻若低於目前用量，會等下一次實際跨過才通知。

macOS 的通知權限若已關閉，選單也會說明，並提供直接開啟通知設定的項目。以前可能看見提醒已開啟，實際卻收不到通知，現在能從選單看出是哪裡沒放行。
body.en:
When asking AI to help revise a report, you can choose alert percentages from the menu to get an early warning that your quota is running low. ⟦The oven used to have only an alert switch; now you can choose the mark where it rings. Setting the alert mark below the current reading does not make it ring retroactively—it waits until the next actual crossing.⟧

“Usage Alert Notifications” is now a submenu on macOS and in the Windows tray (the area that groups icons for background apps). It includes an on/off switch and checkmarks for 50/70/80/90/95%. A newly added threshold below current usage waits until the next actual crossing before notifying you.

If macOS notification permission is off, the menu explains this and offers an item that opens Notification settings directly. Previously, alerts could look enabled even though notifications could not arrive; now the menu shows where permission is missing.

items.original:
**Choose quota-alert thresholds from the menu.** "Usage Alert Notifications" is now a submenu on macOS and in the Windows tray: an on/off switch plus 50/70/80/90/95% checkmarks. A threshold added below current usage waits for the next real crossing instead of firing at once.
**The menu tells you when macOS notification permission is off.** An item opens Notification settings, so alerts that would never arrive no longer look enabled.

title.zh-TW: classic 面板把額度重點留給百分比與紅色警示
title.en: The classic panel puts quota percentages and red alerts first

body.zh-TW:
打開 usage 想確認還能用多少額度，最需要先找到的是百分比與警示。classic 面板現在淡化卡片名稱與專案數字，讓百分比和紅色警示突出，卡片左側的色條也拿掉了。

當額度卡有四張以上，精簡版面會連專案卡與底部一起收緊，不只縮小額度卡本身。繁中、簡中、日文與韓文介面裡，原本的「Session」工作階段標籤也改成「5 小時」，直接寫出這欄代表的時間範圍。

⟦像整理一張貼滿彩色標籤的家用帳單，以前標題、編號和應繳金額都搶著吸引目光；現在收起裝飾、淡化旁支資訊，把目光留給要確認的數字。⟧
body.en:
When you open usage to check how much quota remains, percentages and alerts are what you need to find first. The classic panel now tones down card titles and project numbers so percentages and red alerts stand out, and removes the color bar on the left of each card.

With four or more quota cards, the compact layout also tightens the projects card and footer, instead of shrinking only the quota cards themselves. In the Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean interfaces, the “Session” label now reads “5 hours,” directly stating the time span this field represents.

⟦Think of tidying a household bill covered in colorful labels: the title, reference number and amount due used to compete for attention. Now the decorations are put away and secondary details toned down, leaving your attention on the numbers you need to check.⟧

title.zh-TW: Codex 的舊讀數不再掛上警告符號
title.en: Older Codex readings no longer carry a warning symbol

body.zh-TW:
看到 Codex 額度旁寫著「…前更新」，不必光憑這行字就認定讀取出了問題。⟦車站以前把定時公布的時刻表也貼上故障警告，乘客容易誤會；現在把正常的更新時間留作註記，只有該更新卻沒取得資料時才掛警示。⟧

Codex 沒有即時回報，讀數舊一點是正常情況。usage 現在把所有面板主題，以及 Claude Code 側邊面板裡的這個標籤，都改成灰字，並拿掉 ⚠ 符號。你仍看得到資料多久前更新，只是不再被當成異常。

Antigravity 的警告則保留，因為它的舊值代表抓取失敗。兩者雖然都可能顯示較早的數字，背後原因不同，畫面也跟著分開處理。
body.en:
Seeing “updated … ago” beside your Codex quota does not, by itself, mean something went wrong with the reading. ⟦A station used to put fault warnings even on timetables published at regular intervals, confusing passengers. Now normal update times stay as notes, and a warning appears only when data was due but could not be obtained.⟧

Codex has no live report, so a slightly older reading is normal. Across all panel themes and in the Claude Code side pane, usage now shows this label in muted text without the ⚠ symbol. You can still see how long ago the data was updated; it is simply no longer treated as a problem.

Antigravity keeps its warning because an old value there means a fetch failed. Both may show older numbers, but the reasons differ, and the display now treats them separately.

items.original: **Codex's "updated … ago" label is no longer a warning.** Codex has no live report, so an older reading is normal; every panel theme and the Claude Code side pane now show it in muted text without ⚠. Antigravity keeps its warning, since an old value there means a fetch failed.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式會略過你已主動使用的詞
title.en: Beginner mode skips terms you already use yourself

body.zh-TW:
已經會在訊息裡談 PR 或 commit，卻還一直收到這些詞的解釋，提示就有點多餘了。⟦家教以前只照生字表反覆講解，現在會留意學生自己用出的詞；不過學生開口問意思，仍然算在求教，不會被當成已經學會。⟧

新手模式現在會略過出現在你自己訊息裡的術語，例如 PR（請別人審查並合併修改的請求）不再回來當提示。commit（把一批修改存成版本紀錄）也適用這個規則。

但你若是在問「launchd 是什麼」，這類詢問詞義的訊息不算已經會用，仍可收到解釋。若略過的詞其實還不懂，也能在歷史面板把它標成「不懂」，讓它重新回到提示裡。
body.en:
If you already discuss PRs or commits in your messages, repeated explanations of those terms can feel unnecessary. ⟦A tutor used to explain words repeatedly just by following a vocabulary list; now the tutor notices words the student uses independently. But asking what a word means still counts as seeking help, rather than proof that the student has learned it.⟧

Beginner mode now skips terms that appear in your own messages. For example, PR (a request for others to review and merge changes) no longer returns as a hint. The same rule applies to commit (saving a set of changes as a version record).

But asking “What is launchd?” does not count as already knowing how to use the term, so you can still receive an explanation. If you do not actually understand a skipped term, you can mark it as not understood in the history pane to bring it back into the hints.

items.original: **Beginner mode stops hinting words you type yourself.** If a term such as PR or commit appears in your own message, it no longer comes back as a hint. Asking what a word means ("launchd 是什麼") does not count, and marking the term as not understood in the history pane brings it back.

title.zh-TW: 額度提醒不再認錯帳號或重複報警
title.en: Quota reminders no longer mix up accounts or repeat warnings

body.zh-TW:
換了 Claude 帳號，卻收到上一個帳號的額度提醒，很容易搞不清楚自己還能用多少。以前用 `/login` 換帳號後，新工作階段（這次對話的執行期間）在第一則回覆前，會沿用上次已知的數字。

狀態列 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在會記下是哪個對話讀到這些數字。額度提醒會忽略來自其他對話的讀數，避免把上一個帳號的額度算到你頭上。

Antigravity 的重置時間在不同讀取之間，最多會飄動一分鐘，以前因此被誤認為新的額度窗口。現在同一個對話不會再重複同一則警告。

⟦值班員以前會把前位住客的帳單交給新住客，也會把同一張催繳單重送；現在先核對收件對象，也認得已經送過的通知。⟧
body.en:
Switching Claude accounts and then receiving a quota reminder for the previous account can make it hard to tell how much you have left. Previously, after switching accounts with `/login`, a new session (the running period of this conversation) reused the last known numbers until its first reply.

The status line hook (a small program triggered by specific events) now records which conversation observed those numbers. Quota reminders ignore readings from other conversations, avoiding attributing the previous account’s quota to you.

Antigravity’s reset time can drift by up to a minute between readings, which previously made it look like a new quota window. The same warning now no longer repeats within one conversation.

⟦An attendant used to hand the previous guest’s bill to a new guest and deliver the same payment reminder again. Now the attendant checks the recipient first and recognizes notices already delivered.⟧

items.original:
**After switching Claude accounts with `/login`, the quota reminder no longer reports the previous account's quota as yours.** A new session reuses the last known numbers until its first reply; the status line hook now records which session observed them, and the quota reminder ignores numbers from another session.
**The quota reminder no longer repeats the same Antigravity warning in one conversation.** Antigravity's reset time drifts by up to a minute between readings, which looked like a new quota window.

title.zh-TW: usage 自動修復與開關狀態不再互相打架
title.en: usage self-repair and switch states no longer clash

body.zh-TW:
電腦裡留著不同版本的 usage，或 Claude 狀態列已交給別的工具，原本都可能讓自動修復出岔。hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）以前只要版本不同就重裝，兩份 usage 可能來回替換它。現在只會升級，舊版不會把新版裝好的降回去。

狀態列開關只有在使用 usage 自己的 hook 時才顯示開啟。安裝失敗會明說，登入時啟動若被系統拒絕，也會顯示原因。

即使別的工具掌管 Claude 狀態列，對話工作階段相關的 hook 仍會自我修復。某個工具的額度數字若已一小時以上沒更新，提醒也會說明額度窗口可能已重置。你能分清楚是開關沒設成功，還是眼前的數字已經過時。
body.en:
Keeping different versions of usage on your computer, or letting another tool manage the Claude status line, could previously cause self-repair to go wrong. A hook (a small program triggered by specific events) used to be reinstalled whenever its version differed, so two copies of usage could keep replacing it. Now self-repair only upgrades; an older version will not downgrade what a newer version installed.

The status-line switch shows as on only when usage’s own hook is in use. Failed installations are stated explicitly, and if the system refuses launch-at-login registration, the reason is shown too.

Hooks related to conversation sessions still repair themselves even when another tool manages the Claude status line. If a tool’s quota numbers have not updated for an hour or more, the reminder also explains that the quota window may have reset. You can tell whether a switch failed to take effect or the numbers in front of you are outdated.

items.original:
**An older copy of usage no longer downgrades the hooks a newer one installed.** Self-repair used to reinstall any hook whose version differed, so two copies could keep swapping it; it now only upgrades.
**Status-line and launch-at-login switches no longer fail silently.** The status-line switch is on only for usage's own hook, a failed install says so, and a refused launch-at-login registration shows the reason.
**Session hooks are repaired even when another tool owns the Claude status line.** The quota reminder also says when a tool's numbers are an hour or more old and the window may have reset.

title.zh-TW: Muse 額度檢查減少模型呼叫，卡住也能隨 app 結束
title.en: Muse quota checks use fewer model calls and stop with the app if stuck

body.zh-TW:
只是重新整理額度卡，也會花掉模型呼叫，等於查用量本身還在增加用量。Muse 1.4.13 以上現在改讀 `muse usage --json` 的額度結果，這個查詢不會執行模型，因此額度卡不再每次重新整理都呼叫模型。

舊版 Muse，或還沒有讀數的額度窗口，仍會採用備援方式，退回原本的一行 `muse exec` 檢查。省下模型呼叫有版本與讀數條件，並不是所有情況都取消舊方法。

若 `muse usage` 檢查卡住，結束 app 時也會一併停掉它。

⟦查水費以前得先開水龍頭測試，現在能直接讀水表；還讀不到水表時才沿用舊辦法，離開時也會關掉卡住的測試。⟧
body.en:
Even refreshing a quota card used to spend a model call, meaning that checking usage itself added to usage. With Muse 1.4.13 or later, usage now reads quota results from `muse usage --json`. This query runs no model, so the quota card no longer calls a model on every refresh.

Older Muse versions, or quota windows with no reading yet, still use a fallback: the original one-line `muse exec` check. Saving model calls depends on the version and available readings; the old method has not been removed in every situation.

If a `muse usage` check gets stuck, quitting the app stops it too.

⟦Checking the water bill used to require turning on the tap for a test; now you can read the water meter directly. The old method is used only when the meter cannot yet be read, and any stuck test is shut off when you leave.⟧

items.original:

title.zh-TW: 對話交接只把成功的修改列為完成
title.en: Conversation handoffs mark only successful changes as done

body.zh-TW:
把工作交給下一段對話時，最怕交接內容說已經做好，實際檔案卻沒改成。現在工作階段（這次對話的執行期間）交接時，只把成功的修改列為完成。這些修改包括 commit（把修改存成版本紀錄）與編輯。

如果 commit 被 pre-commit hook（儲存版本前觸發的檢查小程式）擋下，或編輯失敗，都不會再被寫成已完成。用 `!` 執行的 shell（接收並執行文字指令的程式）指令，也不會再被當成你上一個需求。

⟦接班紀錄以前把送修申請當成修好，也把旁邊的操作便條當成客人委託；現在只在完工欄記下成功的工作，操作便條也不再冒充委託內容。⟧
body.en:
When handing work over to the next conversation, a major concern is a handoff saying something is done when the files were never successfully changed. Session (the running period of this conversation) handoffs now mark only successful changes as done. These include commits (saving changes as a version record) and edits.

If a commit is blocked by a pre-commit hook (a small checking program triggered before saving a version), or an edit fails, it is no longer recorded as completed. Commands run with `!` in a shell (a program that accepts and runs text commands) are also no longer treated as your last request.

⟦Shift handover records used to count a repair request as a completed repair and mistake an operating note beside it for a customer request. Now only successful work goes in the completed column, and operating notes no longer pass for customer requests.⟧

items.original: **Session handoffs only list commits and edits that succeeded.** A commit rejected by a pre-commit hook or a failed edit no longer shows as done, and `!` shell commands are no longer listed as your last request.

entries: **The quota keepers and the Antigravity and Muse quota checks now find CLIs installed with nvm, Volta, fnm, mise, asdf, bun or pnpm.** The menu bar app starts with a short PATH, so these installs used to look missing, and npm-installed tools could not find `node`.

**Turning off the status line from the menu now stays off after a restart.** The app used to turn it back on at the next launch. Uninstalling also restores your own status line if you had turned it off, instead of deleting it.
**A broken `~/.claude/settings.json` no longer stops the menu bar app from starting.** The app skips the setup prompt and keeps showing usage for every tool.

**Uninstalling removes everything usage added to Claude Code.** `usage unsetup` and `--unsetup` now also turn off the quota reminder hook, the side panel and beginner mode; your own hooks and settings stay.
**Antigravity usage updates while a conversation is still running.** New usage written to the database's journal file used to wait until the conversation ended.
**A custom Claude Code data folder (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) refreshes as fast as the default one.** Changes there could take up to 15 minutes to appear.
**The Codex reset time no longer keeps moving.** When Codex reports only "resets in N seconds", the countdown now starts from when that message was logged, not from each refresh.

**The terminal report shows local times.** Reset times and session start times were shown in UTC, and daily averages near midnight used the UTC date. Tables whose records all have zero tokens no longer crash, the per-minute rate in the blocks view no longer counts cache reads (matching the menu bar), and `usage sessions --sort sessions` falls back to the default order instead of crashing.

**The HTML report's Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days and This month count from the day the report was made.** They used to count from the last day with usage, so Today could show a day from last week. The report also opens after you change time zones, or when a transcript has a timestamp without a time zone.
**The menu bar icons follow the top three tools even when their percentages are equal.** On daylight saving days, the Today project ranking also counts the first hour correctly.

**Codex setup no longer edits text inside your `config.toml` instructions.** If a multi-line instruction contains a line such as `[tui]`, setup leaves the file unchanged and asks you to adjust `status_line` by hand.

**The curl install script and the LaunchAgent script work again.** The install script downloaded the hook from a folder that no longer exists, and the LaunchAgent script failed on accounts without `~/Library/LaunchAgents`.

title.zh-TW: 報表對齊本地時間與產生日，修復統計偏差與當掉問題
title.en: Reports Align with Local Time and Generation Dates, Fixing Skewed Stats and Crashes

body.zh-TW:
想精確掌握每日的用量花費，現在終端機與 HTML 報表都能忠實反映你的本地作息。

終端機報表的重置時間與工作階段開始時間改用本地時間，午夜前後的日均值也不再依 UTC 計算。紀錄全是零 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）的表格不再當掉。區塊畫面的每分鐘速率不再計入快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存直接用）讀取，與選單列保持一致。執行 `usage sessions --sort sessions` 時會自動套用預設排序，不再當掉。

HTML 報表的「今日／最近 7 天／最近 30 天／本月」改從產生日起算，不再以最後有用量的那天計算而顯示成上週資料。切換時區或對話紀錄含有未標時區的時間戳記時，報表皆可正常打開。

選單列前三名工具百分比相同時圖示會跟著更換，夏令時間切換當天的專案排行也會正確算入第一個小時。
body.en:
If you want to track daily usage expenses precisely, terminal and HTML reports now faithfully reflect your local schedule.

Reset times and session start times in terminal reports now use local time, and daily averages around midnight are no longer calculated using UTC dates. Tables whose records are all zero tokens (units of text processed and billed by AI) no longer crash. The per-minute rate in the blocks view no longer counts cache reads, matching the menu bar. Running `usage sessions --sort sessions` automatically applies the default sort order instead of crashing.

Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days and This month in the HTML report now count from the day the report was generated instead of the last day with usage, preventing them from showing data from last week. The report also opens properly after switching time zones or when transcripts contain timestamps without a time zone.

Menu bar icons update accordingly when the top three tools share equal percentages, and project rankings on daylight saving transition days now correctly include the first hour.

items.original:
**The terminal report shows local times.** Reset times and session start times were shown in UTC, and daily averages near midnight used the UTC date. Tables whose records all have zero tokens no longer crash, the per-minute rate in the blocks view no longer counts cache reads (matching the menu bar), and `usage sessions --sort sessions` falls back to the default order instead of crashing.
**The HTML report's Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days and This month count from the day the report was made.** They used to count from the last day with usage, so Today could show a day from last week. The report also opens after you change time zones, or when a transcript has a timestamp without a time zone.
**The menu bar icons follow the top three tools even when their percentages are equal.** On daylight saving days, the Today project ranking also counts the first hour correctly.

entries: **Report charts now state their conclusion.** Each section title says what the data shows, such as "Claude Code leads with 66% of tokens", with a subtitle and source line under the chart. Tools, projects and cache hit rate become thin bars on a 0-100% axis, token composition is one stacked bar, and the weekly list becomes a column chart that marks the busiest and latest complete weeks.

**The report opens faster on heavy history.** The usage-habits section keeps its profile for an hour instead of five minutes, so most report opens skip rescanning every session file. Usage numbers and charts stay live.
**The menu bar shows the Antigravity recovery countdown again.** When quota is used up, it shows the time left until recovery and keeps refreshing at the short polling interval.

**Auto-open the next Claude window works again.** Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stops reporting the 5-hour window once it expires, so the keeper never saw it expire and never opened the next one. It now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window after it passes. Plans without a 5-hour limit are unaffected.

**Reset Claude quota rows and recovery notifications work again.** Since 0.34.10, the 5-hour and weekly rows showed `--` after a reset, and quota-restored notifications waited until the next Claude reply. The hook now keeps each expired window for one full cycle so readers show 0% and the reset message, and recovery notifications arrive at reset. Plans without a 5-hour limit still drop that window after a full cycle; weekly updates keep working.

body.zh-TW: 當你打開用量報表想快速掌握整體的呼叫狀況時，不再需要對著複雜圖表逐項心算。⟦有如收到整頓後的健檢摘要，以前整頁只印滿密密麻麻的化驗數字，得逐項翻找對照標準；現在每區頂端直接印出重點結論，各項指標也縮成清楚的進度條。⟧現在報表每一區的標題會直接寫出結論，例如「Claude Code 以 66% 的 token 領先」，圖下並附上副標題與資料來源。這裡的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）組成現在改成一條堆疊長條。工具、專案與快取（將運算結果暫存供後續取用）命中率，則全數換成 0 到 100% 刻度的細長條。每週清單也改成直條圖，並替你標出最忙碌與最近一個完整週。

Here, token (the text units AI processes and bills) composition has been changed into a single stacked bar. Tools, projects, and cache hit rates have all been switched to thin bars on a 0 to 100% scale. body.zh-TW: 累積了大量歷史紀錄的使用者，以往每次開啟用量報表往往需要耗費時間等待重新載入。⟦跟常客走進熟識的咖啡館一樣，櫃檯直接調出你常點的喜好清單，不必每次重新翻閱歷來點單；至於收銀機上的當日銷額與即時牌價，則隨時都在同步刷新。⟧現在使用習慣區的分析結果改為保留一小時，不再像過去每五分鐘就必須重新計算。這讓多數開啟報表的時刻，可以直接略過重新掃描所有工作階段（session，單次交談歷程）檔案的流程。所有用量數據與圖表依然維持即時更新，不會因為分析結果保留而延遲呈現。

title.zh-TW: 修復額度恢復倒數、重置顯示與 Claude 視窗排程
title.en: Fix quota recovery countdowns, reset displays, and Claude window scheduling

body.zh-TW:
仰賴用量工具掌握模型配額的讀者，在額度耗盡或重置時能重新獲得即時狀態。

選單列已恢復顯示 Antigravity 額度的恢復倒數。當額度用完時會顯示距離恢復的剩餘時間，並維持短間隔更新頻率。

自 0.34.10 起，Claude Code 在 5 小時視窗過期後便不再回報，導致自動啟動無法偵測過期而停擺。現在工具會記住上次看到的重置時間，時間一過就照常開啟下一個視窗；沒有 5 小時額度的方案不受影響。

同樣從 0.34.10 起出現的顯示問題，也讓 5 小時與每週列在重置後顯示 `--`，額度恢復通知更被延至下一則回覆才發出。現在 hook（特定事件發生時自動觸發的小程式）會多保留過期視窗一整個週期，讓讀取端照常顯示 0% 與已重置，並在重置時立即送出恢復通知。沒有 5 小時額度的方案在超過一整個週期後仍會移除視窗，每週額度則持續更新。
body.en:
Readers who rely on usage tools to track model quotas can now regain real-time status when quotas are exhausted or reset.

The menu bar has restored displaying the Antigravity quota recovery countdown. When quota is used up, it shows the remaining time until recovery and maintains a short update interval.

Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stopped reporting the 5-hour window once it expired, causing auto-open to fail to detect the expiration and stall. The tool now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window as usual once that time passes; plans without a 5-hour quota are unaffected.

A display issue that also appeared since 0.34.10 caused the 5-hour and weekly rows to show `--` after a reset, while quota recovery notifications were delayed until the next reply was sent. Now the hook (a small program automatically triggered by specific events) retains expired windows for one full cycle, allowing readers to display 0% and reset status as usual, and immediately sends recovery notifications upon reset. Plans without a 5-hour quota still remove the window after more than a full cycle, while weekly quotas continue to update.

items.original:
**The menu bar shows the Antigravity recovery countdown again.** When quota is used up, it shows the time left until recovery and keeps refreshing at the short polling interval.
**Auto-open the next Claude window works again.** Since 0.34.10, Claude Code stops reporting the 5-hour window once it expires, so the keeper never saw it expire and never opened the next one. It now remembers the last reset time it saw and opens the next window after it passes. Plans without a 5-hour limit are unaffected.
**Reset Claude quota rows and recovery notifications work again.** Since 0.34.10, the 5-hour and weekly rows showed `--` after a reset, and quota-restored notifications waited until the next Claude reply. The hook now keeps each expired window for one full cycle so readers show 0% and the reset message, and recovery notifications arrive at reset. Plans without a 5-hour limit still drop that window after a full cycle; weekly updates keep working.

entries: **A used-up quota now shows how long until it comes back.** When a tool's 5-hour or weekly quota reaches 100%, the menu bar shows the time left, such as `2h55m`, instead of a stuck `100%`. If both are used up, it counts down to the later reset; if the reset time is unknown, it keeps showing `100%`. While a countdown is shown, the menu bar refreshes every minute instead of every five. The Claude Code status line does the same in red and keeps the time left even in a narrow terminal.

**The status line no longer freezes quota on plans without a 5-hour limit.** Since Claude Code 2.1.316, accounts with no 5-hour limit (such as the Ultra plan) get only the weekly window. The status line treated that as missing data and kept showing the last full snapshot, so the weekly bar stopped moving and an expired 5-hour bar stayed on screen. The menu bar reads a weekly-only status the same way instead of waiting for both windows. Thanks to @dvdmaru for the report and fix (#273).

title.zh-TW: 選單列與狀態列在額度用完時改倒數剩餘時間

title.zh-TW: 無 5 小時額度方案不再卡死狀態列與選單列
title.en: Plans Without a 5-Hour Limit No Longer Freeze the Status Line and Menu Bar

body.zh-TW: 若你使用的是沒有 5 小時額度限制的帳號方案，最近可能遇過用量數據完全凍結不動的狀況。從 Claude Code 2.1.316 開始，沒有 5 小時額度的帳號（例如 Ultra 方案）只會收到每週額度數據。過去 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）會把這種單一額度當成資料不全，導致畫面一直卡在最後一次的完整紀錄：每週額度條停止跳動，過期的 5 小時額度條也遲遲不退場。現在各個額度窗口改為各自獨立更新，Claude Code 不再送來的額度只要過了重置時間便會自動隱藏。選單列也同步支援單一額度讀取，不用再苦等兩個額度都到齊。⟦雙欄計分板在更新賽況時，以前若少了一組比賽成績，整面看板就會卡在上一輪的舊紀錄；現在每組各自刷新，不再開打的場次過期後便自動撤下。⟧感謝 @dvdmaru 回報問題並提交修復（#273）。
body.en: If you use an account plan with no 5-hour limit, you might have recently experienced usage data freezing completely. Starting in Claude Code 2.1.316, accounts with no 5-hour limit (such as the Ultra plan) receive only weekly quota data. Previously, the status line (the bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) treated this single quota as incomplete data, causing the screen to remain stuck on the last complete snapshot: the weekly bar stopped moving, and the expired 5-hour bar lingered without disappearing. Now, each quota window updates independently, and any quota that Claude Code stops sending will automatically disappear once its reset time has passed. The menu bar also synchronously supports reading a single quota, without having to wait for both quotas to arrive. ⟦Much like a two-column scoreboard updating match results, if one score was missing in the past, the entire board remained stuck on the previous round's old record; now each section refreshes independently, and matches no longer being played are automatically removed once they expire.⟧ Thanks to @dvdmaru for the report and fix (#273).

items.original: **The status line no longer freezes quota on plans without a 5-hour limit.** Since Claude Code 2.1.316, accounts with no 5-hour limit (such as the Ultra plan) get only the weekly window. The status line treated that as missing data and kept showing the last full snapshot, so the weekly bar stopped moving and an expired 5-hour bar stayed on screen. Each window now updates on its own; a window Claude Code stops sending disappears once its reset time has passed. The menu bar reads a weekly-only status the same way instead of waiting for both windows. Thanks to @dvdmaru for the report and fix (#273).

entries: **Downloaded macOS apps now pass signature verification.** The release zip stored copies in place of the symlinks inside the bundled Python framework, so every download through v0.34.8, Homebrew installs included, failed `codesign --verify` with "bundle format is ambiguous", and any later tampering could not be told apart. Releases are now zipped with `ditto`, which keeps the symlinks, and the release job verifies the zipped app's signature before publishing. The download is about 9 MB smaller.

title.zh-TW: macOS 下載版通過系統簽章驗證，安裝包體積縮小 9 MB
title.en: Downloaded macOS apps pass signature verification, and installer size shrinks by 9 MB

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上手動下載應用程式或透過 Homebrew 安裝時，現在能放心地替安裝檔查驗身分。在 v0.34.8 與更早的版本中，釋出的 zip 壓縮檔把內建 Python 框架裡的符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），直接存成了檔案複本。這導致執行 `codesign --verify` 驗證簽章時，都會回傳套件格式不明確（bundle format is ambiguous）的錯誤訊息而失敗，事後若遭竄改也無從分辨。現在發布流程改用 `ditto` 工具壓縮並保留捷徑，發布前也會驗證簽章，下載檔案體積也縮小了約 9 MB。⟦就像翻閱附有索引的旅遊指南，以前若把指針標記印成整份重複地圖，查核印鑑時會因版面混亂而無法辨識真偽；現在維持清楚的指標參照，驗章順利過關，整本手冊也輕盈不少。⟧
body.en: When manually downloading the app on a Mac or installing it through Homebrew, you can now confidently verify the installer's identity. In v0.34.8 and earlier versions, released zip archives stored file copies instead of symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location) inside the bundled Python framework. Because of this, running `codesign --verify` to check signatures always failed with the error message "bundle format is ambiguous", leaving any later tampering undetectable. The release process now compresses archives using the `ditto` tool to preserve shortcuts, also verifies signatures before publishing, and reduces download size by about 9 MB. ⟦Picture flipping through an indexed travel guide: previously, printing pointer markers as entire duplicate maps made it impossible to tell genuine stamps from fake ones due to layout confusion; now, maintaining clear pointer references lets seal verification pass smoothly, and the entire handbook is noticeably lighter.⟧

items.original: **Downloaded macOS apps now pass signature verification.** The release zip stored copies in place of the symlinks inside the bundled Python framework, so every download through v0.34.8, Homebrew installs included, failed `codesign --verify` with "bundle format is ambiguous", and any later tampering could not be told apart. Releases are now zipped with `ditto`, which keeps the symlinks, and the release job verifies the zipped app's signature before publishing. The download is about 9 MB smaller.

entries: **A masked report no longer leaks project names.** When you hid project names and downloaded the HTML report, each project row still carried its real name in a hidden accessibility label, readable by anyone who opened the file's source. Masking now also covers those labels, tooltips and image descriptions.

**Names in an exported CSV no longer run as spreadsheet formulas.** A project or model name starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` was written as-is, so Excel could treat it as a formula. Such names now start with an apostrophe and stay plain text.

**A downloaded project can no longer use its Git settings to run a program through Progress Concierge.** Progress Concierge runs `git status` in your project when a session starts, and a repository's own `.git/config` can tell Git to launch a file-system monitor program. usage now switches that monitor off for its check.

**The macOS app keeps a valid code signature after it runs.** Python wrote its compiled caches into the app on first launch, which broke the signature and made any later tampering impossible to tell apart. The caches are now built before signing, so nothing inside the app changes while it runs. The app is about 2 MB larger.

**Releases are built only from locked, hash-verified build tools.** The PyPI package is built in a step that cannot publish, from a pinned build backend, and the Windows build pins PyInstaller the same way. October's supply-chain attacks published poisoned packages through hijacked release pipelines; this closes that path here. The setuptools used to build the macOS app is also updated to 84.2.1 for GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w.

**Turning on Token Saver no longer breaks some Codex configs.** If `~/.codex/config.toml` wrote the features setting as `features = { hooks = false }` or `features.hooks = false`, usage added a second `[features]` section and Codex then refused to load the file. usage now checks the edited file first and leaves it untouched if the edit would not parse.

**GPT-6.1 Terra is priced while offline.** Codex's new GPT-6.1 Terra model counted as $0 whenever the price table could not be downloaded. The built-in fallback now carries its price, $1 / $5 per million input / output tokens.

**Panel titles no longer cut off the bottoms of g and y.** In the Default, Origami, Stained Glass, Sketchbook, Heart Monitor and Windows 95 panels, titles such as "Antigravity" and "Project Usage" lost the tails of their descenders, because the box that trims long titles was shorter than the letters. The box now has room for them; the layout does not move.
**The app no longer bundles the retired AI Council window.** Its page was left behind when the feature was removed in v0.30.11, and nothing loaded it.

title.zh-TW: 匯出報表徹底遮蓋專案名稱，CSV 檔案防止符號觸發試算表公式
title.en: Exported reports thoroughly mask project names, and CSV files prevent symbols from triggering spreadsheet formulas

body.zh-TW: 需要把專案用量匯出給外部團隊或主管審閱時，檔案本身的隱私與安全性現在有了更周全的防護。以往隱藏專案名稱並下載 HTML 報表，每一列資料其實還把真名藏在給輔助工具讀取的標籤裡，打開檔案原始碼就看得到。現在遮罩連同這些標籤、滑鼠提示與圖片說明一起蓋掉。若是匯出 CSV 檔案，專案名或模型名以 `=`、`+`、`-`、`@` 開頭時，舊版會原樣寫出，Excel 可能把它當成公式執行。現在這類名稱開頭會自動加上一個單引號，維持純文字呈現。⟦處理公文寄送時，以前若只用奇異筆塗黑紙面，背後的複寫痕跡仍會透光看見，特殊符號甚至會被自動掃描機誤當操作指令；現在底層複寫與附註會同步塗銷，開頭也加註標記維持純文字讀取。⟧
body.en: When you need to export project usage for external teams or managers to review, the privacy and security of the files themselves now have more comprehensive protection. Previously, when hiding project names and downloading an HTML report, each row of data actually still hid the real name inside a label read by assistive tools, visible to anyone opening the file's source code. Masking now covers those labels along with tooltips and image descriptions. If exporting a CSV file, when a project name or model name started with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@`, the older version wrote it as-is, so Excel could execute it as a formula. Such names now automatically start with a single quote to remain plain text. ⟦Think of dispatching official documents: in the past, blacking out paper with a marker still left carbon-copy traces visible against the light, and special symbols could even be mistaken for operational commands by automatic scanners; now underlying copies and notes are erased at the same time, with a prefix mark added to keep them read as plain text.⟧

items.original:
**A masked report no longer leaks project names.** When you hid project names and downloaded the HTML report, each project row still carried its real name in a hidden accessibility label, readable by anyone who opened the file's source. Masking now also covers those labels, tooltips and image descriptions.
**Names in an exported CSV no longer run as spreadsheet formulas.** A project or model name starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` was written as-is, so Excel could treat it as a formula. Such names now start with an apostrophe and stay plain text.

title.zh-TW: 進度管家在對話檢查時停用檔案監控，防止外部專案擅自執行程式
title.en: Progress Concierge disables file monitoring during session checks to prevent external projects from running programs without permission

body.zh-TW: 從網路下載開源專案來進行分析，最怕專案自帶的設定檔趁著背景檢查偷偷啟動惡意程式。⟦走進大樓櫃檯登記入內時，以前訪客繳交的證件若夾帶自動呼叫裝置，保全一翻開封面就會不知不覺觸發它運作；現在安檢只核對身分並切斷隨附的連動線路，杜絕未經許可的額外動作。⟧每當工作階段開始，進度管家會在專案目錄裡執行 `git status` 檢查目前狀態。然而專案自身的 `.git/config` 設定檔，原本可以指示 Git 同步啟動一支檔案監控程式，下載來的陌生專案便可能藉此暗中執行有害程式。現在 usage 執行這項檢查時會關閉檔案系統監控，防止下載的專案透過這項設定啟動程式。
body.en: When downloading open-source projects from the internet for analysis, the biggest worry is that bundled configuration files might sneakily launch malicious programs during background checks. ⟦Picture signing in at a building front desk: in the past, if a visitor's badge carried an automated pager, a security guard opening the cover would trigger it without knowing; now security checks only verify identity and cut off any accompanying trigger lines, stopping unauthorized actions entirely.⟧ Whenever a session begins, Progress Concierge runs `git status` in the project directory to check current status. However, a repository's own `.git/config` configuration file could originally instruct Git to launch a file-system monitor program at the same time, allowing an unfamiliar downloaded project to covertly execute harmful programs. usage now disables file-system monitoring when performing this check, preventing downloaded projects from launching programs through this setting.

items.original: **A downloaded project can no longer use its Git settings to run a program through Progress Concierge.** Progress Concierge runs `git status` in your project when a session starts, and a repository's own `.git/config` can tell Git to launch a file-system monitor program. usage now switches that monitor off for its check.

title.zh-TW: macOS 程式簽章執行後維持有效，發版流程鎖定建置工具防禦供應鏈攻擊
title.en: macOS code signatures remain valid after execution, and release pipelines lock build tools against supply-chain attacks

body.zh-TW: 在使用桌面應用程式或更新軟體時，程式本身的完整性有了明確把關。⟦檢驗精密儀器的出廠包裝時，以前開機運作就會破壞防偽封條，組裝工具遭竄改更可能混入瑕疵；現在封條在出廠前已妥善固化，產線也只採用驗證過規格的專用設備。⟧macOS app 第一次啟動時，以前 Python 會把編譯快取（把編譯結果暫存起來直接使用的檔案）寫進 app 裡，導致簽章失效且難以辨識竄改。現在快取在簽章前就先編好，執行時內部不再變動，簽章持續有效，app 大約多 2 MB。發布流程也防堵供應鏈攻擊。PyPI 套件改在無發布權限的步驟建置，工具版本鎖定並驗證雜湊；Windows 版的 PyInstaller 同樣鎖定，防範 10 月出現的劫持風險。打包 macOS app 用的 setuptools 亦升至 84.2.1，修補 GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w。
body.en: When using desktop applications or updating software, the integrity of the program itself now has clear safeguards. ⟦Inspecting factory packaging for precision instruments offers a comparison: previously, turning on the machine broke the tamper-evident seal, and altered assembly tools could introduce flaws; now seals are properly cured before shipping, and production lines use only dedicated equipment with verified specifications.⟧ On first launch of the macOS app, Python previously wrote its compiled caches into the app, which broke the signature and made any later tampering impossible to identify. Caches are now built before signing, so nothing inside changes during execution, keeping the signature valid and making the app about 2 MB larger. The release workflow also defends against supply-chain attacks. The PyPI package is now built in a step without publishing permissions, with tool versions locked and hashes verified; the Windows version of PyInstaller is locked the same way to prevent hijacking risks that emerged in October. The setuptools used to package the macOS app is also upgraded to 84.2.1 to patch GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w.

items.original:
**The macOS app keeps a valid code signature after it runs.** Python wrote its compiled caches into the app on first launch, which broke the signature and made any later tampering impossible to tell apart. The caches are now built before signing, so nothing inside the app changes while it runs. The app is about 2 MB larger.
**Releases are built only from locked, hash-verified build tools.** The PyPI package is built in a step that cannot publish, from a pinned build backend, and the Windows build pins PyInstaller the same way. October's supply-chain attacks published poisoned packages through hijacked release pipelines; this closes that path here. The setuptools used to build the macOS app is also updated to 84.2.1 for GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w.

title.zh-TW: 開啟省 token 模式不再損毀 Codex 設定檔，離線時為 GPT-6.1 Terra 補齊計價
title.en: Turning on Token Saver no longer corrupts Codex configs, and pricing is filled in for GPT-6.1 Terra while offline

body.zh-TW: 平時若習慣為 Codex 開啟省 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）模式，或常在離線環境工作，現在能更穩妥維護設定與統計開銷。若 `~/.codex/config.toml` 寫成 `features = { hooks = false }` 或 `features.hooks = false`，舊版多加 `[features]` 會讓 Codex 無法載入；現在會先檢查修改後的內容能否解析；若修改會讓檔案無法解析，就保留原檔。若價目表下載失敗，GPT-6.1 Terra 原本算為 $0；現在內建備援收錄價格，每百萬 token 輸入 $1、輸出 $5。⟦諮詢秘書整理帳冊時，以前見到特殊格式就硬加欄位導致整本報廢，離線時更把新服務當成免費招待；現在會先驗證改好的版本，確認格式沒壞才替換原本帳冊，斷網時也能查閱隨身底冊如實計價。⟧
body.en: If you regularly enable Token Saver mode for Codex to conserve tokens (text units processed and billed by AI), or often work in offline environments, you can now maintain settings and track spending more reliably. If `~/.codex/config.toml` was written as `features = { hooks = false }` or `features.hooks = false`, older versions added an extra `[features]` section that prevented Codex from loading; it now checks whether the modified content parses first, leaving the original file untouched if the edit would fail to parse. If downloading the price table failed, GPT-6.1 Terra originally counted as $0; the built-in fallback now includes its pricing, at $1 for input and $5 for output per million tokens. ⟦A secretary organizing account ledgers faced similar challenges: previously, forcing extra columns into an unfamiliar format ruined the entire book, and working offline led to treating new services as complimentary; now the revised version is verified first, replacing the original ledger only after confirming the format remains intact, while a pocket ledger is consulted to price services accurately during network outages.⟧

items.original:
**Turning on Token Saver no longer breaks some Codex configs.** If `~/.codex/config.toml` wrote the features setting as `features = { hooks = false }` or `features.hooks = false`, usage added a second `[features]` section and Codex then refused to load the file. usage now checks the edited file first and leaves it untouched if the edit would not parse.
**GPT-6.1 Terra is priced while offline.** Codex's new GPT-6.1 Terra model counted as $0 whenever the price table could not be downloaded. The built-in fallback now carries its price, $1 / $5 per million input / output tokens.

title.zh-TW: 面板標題保留英文字尾完整顯示，並移除已下架的 AI 圓桌頁面
title.en: Panel titles fully display English letter descenders, and the retired AI Council page is removed

body.zh-TW: 換上不同主題面板瀏覽專案用量，標題文字不再因為邊框過矮而出現破版截斷。在預設、摺紙、彩繪玻璃、手繪筆記、心電圖和視窗 95 面板裡，「Antigravity」與「Project Usage」等標題中的 g 與 y，字尾以往會被切掉下半截。這是因為裁切長標題的外框比字體還矮，現在外框替字尾留出空間，維持版面位置不變。應用程式也不再夾帶已下架的 AI 圓桌視窗。v0.30.11 下架該功能時漏刪了頁面，由於沒有任何程式會載入它，本版已將其清理移除。⟦挑選展覽相框時，以前邊框尺寸比照片還小導致邊緣文字被壓扁，倉庫角落甚至還留著前年撤展的空展牌；現在相框預留足夠邊界完整襯托字樣，閒置已久的展板也一併清空撤離。⟧
body.en: When switching between themed panels to browse project usage, title text is no longer cut off due to overly short bounding boxes. In the Default, Origami, Stained Glass, Sketchbook, Heart Monitor, and Windows 95 panels, titles such as "Antigravity" and "Project Usage" previously had the lower halves of descenders on letters g and y cut off. This happened because the frame trimming long titles was shorter than the font; the frame now leaves room for descenders while keeping layout positioning unchanged. The application also no longer bundles the retired AI Council window. When v0.30.11 retired this feature, its page was left behind, and because no program loaded it, this version cleans up and removes it. ⟦Framing artwork for an exhibition works the same way: previously, frames smaller than the photos squashed marginal lettering, and warehouse corners still held empty signboards from displays dismantled two years ago; now frames preserve ample borders to display lettering fully, while long-idle boards are cleared away together.⟧

**Panel titles no longer cut off the bottoms of g and y.** In the Default, Origami, Stained Glass, Sketchbook, Heart Monitor and Windows 95 panels, titles such as "Antigravity" and "Project Usage" lost the tails of their descenders, because the box that trims long titles was shorter than the letters. The box now has room for them; the layout does not move.
**The app no longer bundles the retired AI Council window.** Its page was left behind when the feature was removed in v0.30.11, and nothing loaded it.
